source_policy: Retired static delivery retained for provenance. Three source arm references were refreshed on 2026-09-27; derived artwork was not regenerated. Historical approved filenames are not current approval. This package cannot be rebuilt as the new expression/pose animation.

delivery_notes.standby: Landscape files are photo sources; StandBy has no generic wallpaper importer.
delivery_notes.watch: Photo-face files are static fallbacks; complication PNGs require a signed WidgetKit app.
delivery_notes.shortcuts: Personal automations are device-specific and must be created manually.
delivery_notes.nfc: A passive NFC tag triggers software only; it cannot power LEDs or other case hardware.
delivery_notes.audio: All sounds are original synthesis with no speech or voice imitation.
